Features

Built to be light, built to be smooth.

Everything a wallpaper engine needs, nothing that slows your machine down.

GPU accelerated

Videos are decoded by your graphics card, so the processor stays free for the things you actually do.

Smart auto-pause

Playback stops for fullscreen apps, maximized windows, the lock screen, a sleeping display and Battery Saver. It resumes instantly.

Live online gallery

New wallpapers appear automatically. Hover a tile to stream a preview, then add it with one click.

Auto-convert

Drop in any video. Larger files are converted to your chosen 720p, 1080p or 1440p and keep up to 60 FPS.

Tune for your PC

Pick 20, 30 or 60 FPS, choose Fill, Fit or Stretch, and let it rotate wallpapers on a timer.

Lives in your tray

Runs quietly in the background. Stop it anytime and your normal Windows wallpaper comes right back.

Real desktop

Your desktop, alive.

Skulls, sunsets or a samurai shiba: any video can be your background, with your icons and taskbar sitting on top exactly like a normal wallpaper.

  • Icons, taskbar and Start menu work as usual
  • Close or minimize a game and the wallpaper picks up right where it should
  • Remove it any time with one button

How it works

Up and running in a minute.

Run the exe

Open AntifyLive.exe once. It asks where to create its folder, copies itself there and adds a Start menu entry.

Pick a wallpaper

Choose from the gallery or upload your own video. It is converted automatically when needed.

Enjoy & forget

It starts with Windows, sits in the tray and pauses itself when it should. Delete the downloaded file if you like.

FAQ

Good to know.

Windows shows a "protected your PC" warning.

The app is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about new files. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". You can compare the SHA-256 above with the downloaded file to be sure it is untouched.

Where does it install and how do I remove it?

You choose the folder on first run. Everything (app, wallpapers, settings) stays in that one folder. Remove it from the Settings tab in the app, or from Windows Settings, Apps.

Will it slow down my games?

It pauses automatically when a fullscreen app is in front, and it runs at below-normal priority so games always come first.

What video files can I use?

MP4 (H.264) works best. MOV, M4V, WMV and AVI are supported too. Videos larger than your chosen quality are converted automatically.

How do I go back to my normal wallpaper?

Click "Stop live wallpaper" in the app or in the tray menu and your regular Windows wallpaper returns instantly.
